title: Spare capacity is leftover behind linear pace of a refresh cycle
description:
As a dispatcher I start spot work only when used fraction lags elapsed fraction of the window (example: 25% used at 50% of the cycle). I do not dispatch just because leftover exists.

Feature: spare pace
  Scenario: behind pace is spare
    Given a weekly window 50% elapsed and 25% used
    And remaining percent is above the floor
    And no hold is set
    When Spotticus scores that pool
    Then the pool is eligible for dispatch

  Scenario: on pace is not spare
    Given a weekly window 50% elapsed and 50% used
    When Spotticus scores that pool
    Then the pool is not eligible for dispatch
